mcq.question: How much memory does the merge phase of the external sort need?

options.C: Nothing; it works on disk only
options.D: About one line per run, plus file buffers

mcq.explanation: The priority queue holds only the current smallest line of each run.

mcq.question: Why is the line assembler tested with every chunk size from 1 byte up?

options.A: Boundary bugs appear only when a line or a \r\n is split at a specific position

mcq.explanation: Trying all sizes guarantees every split position is exercised.

bonus.question: When is it better to use a database or a tool such as `sort` from the shell than to write an external sort yourself?
Make `merge_runs` merge at most k runs at a time (multi-pass merge) and test it with k = 2 on 10 runs.
